title: The standup that would not end
logline: Maya wants one answer from a standup that keeps wandering.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every morning at nine the whole team gathers around one long table to say what they did yesterday and what they hope to do today.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: So yesterday I looked at the dashboard again, and then I looked at the other dashboard, and honestly both of them were fine.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I only need to know if the release is blocked.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Next time I am sending a message.
